title: Reliable Coach Snapshot sharing
details: Large Evia Coach Snapshots now split automatically into a short sequence of QR frames for Milos
The learner only opens Share with assessor once and keeps the screen still while Milos collects every part
Small progress records continue to use the existing single QR format
The Coach Snapshot content and privacy rules are unchanged: no learner identity, media files, signatures or private written wellbeing notes are shared
summary: Evia v232 makes the v231 Coach Snapshot reliable for larger 10-week review records by adding automatic multipart QR transport without changing the data being shared.
changes: Legacy single QR retained for smaller records
Automatic cycling with no learner interaction required
Same anonymous Coach Snapshot privacy boundary
